name: Pure Intention
description: Lighting fixtures found in the Zapolyarny Palace. Their elegant, distinctive design features bases reminiscent of ice flowers.\n"The Tsaritsa's dream is the noblest and purest thing in all the world." Like the Tsaritsa's ideal, these fixtures are crafted from Prime Ice, pure and luminous, casting a gentle light that shines equally upon everyone who passes beneath them.
